entries.zh: 由于无法解决合金短缺，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
entries.en: Having failed to resolve our alloys shortage, we have been forced to declare bankruptcy and default on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new austerity plan to cut expenses and preventing this situation from ever happening again.

entries.zh: 稀有水晶在[Root.Owner.GetName]变得更加稀有了。包括关键的军用器材和先进生产设施中的核心组件，几乎各行各业都发生了短缺。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]提醒，必须在数月之内重整补给链，否则将需要大幅削减开支。
entries.en: Rare crystals are becoming increasingly scarce in the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Shortages have been reported in many fields, ranging from vital military supplies to critical components used in many advanced manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] warns reforms to the supply chain will be necessary within a matter of months, failing which sharp cutbacks will be necessary.

entries.zh: 从首都方舟抽取稀有水晶。
entries.en: Siphon rare crystals from the Capital Arkship.

entries.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
entries.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

entries.zh: 我们可以忍受“超稀有”水晶。
entries.en: We can live with our crystals being rarer.

entries.zh: 我们稀有水晶的供给已经枯竭到即使关键系统都无法获得补充。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]调侃道如今它已经可以称呼为“极稀有”水晶了，他同时还强制执行了急剧的削减以期能恢复收支平衡。
entries.en: Our supply of rare crystals has diminished to the point that even critical systems can no longer be supported. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap], which recommends that they be renamed to "rarest crystals", is enforcing harsh cutbacks to return our usage of them to sustainable levels.

entries.zh: 我们的$rare_crystals$储备已消耗到无法维持多项关键功能的程度。在极端情况下，我们那些依赖这种珍贵资源的特化共生体将面临生命危险。\n\n为避免进一步的生命损失和生产力下滑，我们现在必须采取极端手段来确保系统重新恢复平衡。
entries.en: Our supply of $rare_crystals$ has diminished to the point we can no longer maintain several critical functions. In extreme instances, we risk the lives of our more specialized symbionts who depend on this precious resource.\n\nTo prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now rely on drastic means to ensure we once again reach equilibrium.

entries.zh: 由于管理缺失和大肆的浪费，我们的易爆微粒库存已经完全枯竭！这种战略资源在包括合金冶炼和军事发展等诸多领域有着广泛的应用。尽快补充库存对确保我们帝国经济繁荣至关重要。
entries.en: Due to mismanagement and reckless expenditures, our Volatile Motes reserves have completely evaporated! This strategic resource is widely used in multiple fields, ranging from alloys production to military development. Replenishing our supplies is of paramount importance to ensure the economic prosperity of our empire.

entries.zh: 从首都方舟抽取易爆微粒。
entries.en: Siphon volatile motes from the Capital Arkship.

entries.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
entries.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

entries.zh: 我们可以忍受“超罕见”微粒。
entries.en: We can live with our motes becoming more elusive.

entries.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的经济危机。由于无法弥补赤字，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
entries.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide economic crash. Unable to repay our deficits, we were forced to declare bankruptcy and forfeit on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

entries.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的补给链崩溃。很显然我们已经无法继续维持我们对该物质的消耗。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
entries.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide supply chain crash. It has become clear that we can no longer sustain our use of this material. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

entries.zh: 我们各世界之间$volatile_motes$的短缺已造成广泛的混乱，尤其是那些生命完全依赖于它的极端微生物共生体。为了防止生命和生产力的进一步损失，我们现在必须实行剧烈的变革，以确保基本生命的延续，希望我们能尽快恢复平衡。
entries.en: The shortage of $volatile_motes$ among our worlds has caused widespread disruption, not least to those extremophile worker-symbionts whose very lives depend on it. To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now institute drastic change to ensure basic continuity of life, in the hopes we might soon regain equilibrium.

entries.zh: 异星天然气在我们的国库中已经成了稀罕货——而它们的长期缺失对我们所有依赖它的生产流程都产生了严重的影响。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]强烈建议我们重新考虑预算优先级，以结束这一怪异的局势。
entries.en: Exotic Gases have become a foreign presence in our empire stockpile - and their continued absence is having an impact on our entire manufacturing process, which heavily depends on them. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] strongly suggests we reconsider our budget priorities to put an end to this outlandish situation.

entries.zh: 从首都方舟抽取异星天然气。
entries.en: Siphon exotic gases from the Capital Arkship.

entries.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
entries.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

entries.zh: 我们可以忍受“超难得”天然气。
entries.en: We can live with our gases being more fleeting.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国已经再也无法应付异星天然气短缺对我们生产流程的毁灭性打击。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]被迫宣布破产，使我们得以违约债务。新的紧缩经济计划正在起草以削减开支，这样一来我们就可以逐渐重建我们的资源储备。
entries.en: Our empire can no longer cope with the exotic gas shortages that have been disrupting our manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has been forced to declare bankruptcy, allowing us to forfeit our debts. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, so that we may slowly rebuild our resource stockpile.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国已经再也无法弥补异星天然气短缺对我们生产流程的毁灭性打击。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]被迫宣布破产，使我们得重新组织我们的分配系统，让我们有机会逐渐重新建立资源储备。
entries.en: Our empire can no longer cope with the exotic gas shortages that have been disrupting our manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has been forced to declare bankruptcy, allowing us to reorganize our distribution systems so that we can slowly rebuild our resource stockpile.

entries.zh: 所有与目前§Y[This.GetName]§!有关的惩罚将被移除。
entries.en: All penalties relating to the ongoing §Y[This.GetName]§! will be removed.

entries.zh: 资源将从我们清算的资产中释放出来，以便我们进行重组。
entries.en: Resources will be freed up from our liquidated assets to allow us to rebuild.

entries.zh: 在击败了§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!之后，我们认为在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上举办一场以我们收获的[Root.GetTrophyName]为主题的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]对我们的帝国多有裨益。
entries.en: After defeating the §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!, we believe that a [Owner.GetParadeStudy] on §Y[Target.GetName]§! focusing on the [Root.GetTrophyName] we secured would be very beneficial to our empire.
The [Owner.GetParadeStudy] will happen when [Target.GetName] organizes it.

entries.zh: 暂停局势，解锁一项§Y殖民地决议§!以便把[Owner.GetParadeStudy]搬到那里。
entries.en: Pause the situation and unlock a special §YColony Decision§! to move the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] there.

entries.zh: 通过鼓励这场纪念重大胜利的庆典，我们确信未来将会有更多机会来纪念这一事件。
entries.en: By encouraging the celebration of this grand feat, we are sure to have more opportunities to make this an event to remember.

entries.zh: 一场浮夸无聊的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]一文不值。我们的资源应当用于更需要的地方。
entries.en: There is no value in a frivolous [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Our resources are better placed elsewhere.

entries.zh: 在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]污染被清理干净之前，我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]暂停举办。
entries.en: This [Owner.GetParadeStudy] is on hold until the [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] contamination can cleaned up.

entries.zh: 我们将组织一场[Owner.GetParadeStudy]，以永久增强[Target.GetName]。

entries.en: We will clear up [Target.GetName] and proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].
The final preparations will be made.

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]给养被虚空孳孽的酸性毒液污染了。
entries.en: Our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply has been contaminated with the acidic venom from the Voidspawn.

entries.zh: 如果我们选择研究污染，该§Y局势§!会发展得更慢，但我们将会从这一§Y解决方案§!的进行过程中获得研究点。
entries.en: This §YSituation§! will progress slower if we elect to study the contaminant, but we will gain research along the way from that §YApproach§!.

entries.zh: 我们需要尽快清理掉这些污染，以重新回到我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]中。
entries.en: We need to clean up the contaminant as quickly as possible so we can get back to our [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

entries.zh: 不要浪费这次有价值的机遇，在回到[Owner.GetParadeStudy]之前再研究一下这些污染物。
entries.en: Do not waste this valuable opportunity, let's study the contaminant before returning to the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

entries.zh: 我们的恒星[Target.GetName]最近的行为极度怪异，它的能量产出远远低于平常。如果不能尽快找到应对措施，我们将会面临生态灾难！
entries.en: Our star, [Target.GetName], has been acting extremely oddly recently, generating a lot less energy than usual. If this is not remedied soon we could be facing ecological disaster!

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]将被熄灭，使整个恒星系变得不可居住。
entries.en: [Target.GetName] will be extinguished, rendering the system uninhabitable.
[Target.GetName] will return to its normal state.

entries.zh: 该§Y局势§!的发展进度取决于我们寻找到恢复方案的能力。
entries.en: The progress of this §YSituation§! depends on our ability to find a cure.

entries.zh: 我们需要动员所有的科学家来研究这个怪异的恒星黑子，我们的首都安危在此一举。
entries.en: We need every scientist available to study the strange sunspots. Our Capital depends on it.

entries.zh: 我们终于找到了解决措施，希望不会太晚。
entries.en: We now have a cure. We can only hope that it's not too late.

entries.zh: 不是所有星球都可以举办像[Owner.GetParadeStudy]这么壮观的游行。我们深思熟虑之后认为[GetName]才是更合适的地点。
entries.en: Not every world can host something as grand as the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. After further consideration, we decided [GetName] would be a better suited location.

entries.zh: 这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对§Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。然而，让我们将残余物拖到[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]以后发现，结果并不如我们希望的那么有趣。\n\n就在这项进程开始之后不久，我们决定将研究转移到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。希望能从中有更多的发现。
entries.en: The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the §Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!. As the study, began a small portion of our consciousness focused on §Y[Target.GetName]§! to absorb the study of the anomalous item. However, the revelations were not as interesting as we had hoped as we dragged the remains to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat].\n\nShortly after the process began, we decided to move the study to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. Hopefully something more will come of it.

entries.zh: 这一天终于来临。我们的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对§Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!进行全面的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将一小部分意识集中在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上，以消化吸收对异常项目的研究。当天，整个[Owner.GetName]的产出率整整降低了§H0.2%§!。\n\n探测数据被深深映在我们的意识当中，并转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。
entries.en: The day has arrived. Our [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us a thorough exploration of the §Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!. As the study began, a significant portion of our consciousness focused on §Y[Target.GetName]§! to absorb the import of this anomalous item. Productivity in the [Owner.GetName] was reduced by a whole §H0.2%§! for the day.\n\nThe sensory data was then archived deep in our consciousness before being placed in the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it.

entries.zh: 这一天终于来临。大量[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]已经就位，准备为我们对§Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!进行切实的探索。随着研究的开始，我们将整个意识集中在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上，以消化吸收对这一令我们全神贯注的异常项目的研究。几个危险境地的[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]因一时分神而受伤，甚至还有几个失踪了。我们对此无比痴迷。\n\n在初步研究完成后，我们决定将其转移到到位于[Target.GetName]的中央团簇，由特化的[Owner.GetSensoryWorkers]对其进行持续观测。我们近乎虔诚地部署了这一研究任务，并持续分配一部分意识对其进行观测。
entries.en: The day has arrived. A massive amount of [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] were in place and ready to give us an exacting exploration of the §Y[This.GetTrophyName]§!. As the study began, for a moment, our entire consciousness focused on §Y[Target.GetName]§! to absorb the study of the anomalous item which preoccupied us so. Several [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] caught up in precarious situations were injured in the momentary distraction, and a few were even lost. So great was our fascination.\n\nAfter the initial study was complete, we decided to move it to the center of our cluster on [Target.GetName], where the specialized [Owner.GetSensoryWorkers] will continuously observe it. We placed it down, almost reverently, and continue to dedicate a part of our consciousness to the observation.

entries.zh: 在[This.GetTrophyName]中，我们重新认识了自己。
entries.en: In the [This.GetTrophyName], we have found ourselves.

entries.zh: 今天，§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都的人群们迎来了阴沉的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!的证明，漫步经过叽叽喳喳的围观者。这一过程在全帝国范围内广播，但反响极低，[This.GetTrophyName]似乎没有我们预想的那么令人感兴趣。\n\n在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
entries.en: An overcast day greeted the middling crowd on §Y[Target.GetName]'s§! capital city today. The procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§! ambled past the meandering onlookers. Its progress was broadcast throughout our empire, but engagement was low as the [This.GetTrophyName] did not seem to be quite as enticing as we had hoped.\n\nAfter finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

entries.zh: 今天，§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都的拥挤人群们迎来了阳光明媚的一天。游行的队伍携带着我们摧毁§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!的证明，四处环游逐一展览。游行的过程在全帝国范围内数十亿观众直播。[This.GetTrophyName]一时成为了[Owner.Species.GetAdj]文化的重要象征，激发着全[Owner.GetName]的艺术家和发明家们。\n\n在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
entries.en: A bright day greeted the packed crowds on §Y[Target.GetName]§! today as the procession carrying our proof of the destruction of the §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§! traveled around. The parade's progress was broadcast throughout our empire to billions of viewers. The [This.GetTrophyName] already seems to have become a staple of [Owner.Species.GetAdj] culture, inspiring artists and creators across [Owner.GetName].\n\nAfter finishing the world tour, the [This.GetTrophyName] was placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

entries.zh: 今天，§Y[Target.GetName]§!晴空万里令人心旷神怡，不过这是理所当然的，因为我们把大气调控系统已经满负荷开到爆了。在这伟大的一天，[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]上的每座城市的大街小巷都挤得满满当当，而更多的商旅飞船仍在不断地停泊进行星的轨道。盛大的游行逐一经过每一个定居点，迎接他们的是人山人海的街道和[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们热情的欢呼。我们帝国中每一座能够进行大型全息投影的城市也都挤满了观看盛大全息转播的观众。作为典礼的重中之重，[This.GetTrophyName]抵达了[Target.GetName]的首都，人们已经讨论起了将今天定为每年的§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!节日。在完成了环球展览之后，[This.GetTrophyName]被放在了首都中心进行特展，以激励我们以及子孙后代。
entries.en: The weather on §Y[Target.GetName]§! was unnaturally great today, as it should have been, considering we ran our atmosphere control system on overdrive. Every city on the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat] reached its capacity, and there were still tourist ships orbiting the world just to be a part of this great day. The grand parade traveled through each settlement in turn, and was greeted by streets packed with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Every city capable of requisitioning a holo-display in our empire was also overflowing with spectators for the grand hologram rebroadcasts. As the centerpiece of the parade, the [This.GetTrophyName], reached [Target.GetName]'s capital, people were already talking about making today a yearly §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§! inspired holiday. The [This.GetTrophyName] was then placed in a specialized display at the center of the capital to inspire generations to come.

entries.zh: 又没人来看嚷嚷着办什么庆典啊？
entries.en: If they won't to show up for it, why did they ask for a celebration?
Today was a good day for all [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
We stand united today, as one.

entries.zh: 为了准备那个重要的日子，我们将一颗§Y以太巨龙的獠牙§!转运到§Y[Target.GetName]§!。把它们塞进货运飞船是一项极富挑战的工作，以太巨龙独特的生理构造似乎违背了物理法则。在进入[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]大气层时，獠牙对飞船发生了极其奇怪的反应：它在众目睽睽之下开始瓦解，要不是飞船快速应对，我们可能就会失去这一宝贵的物品。
entries.en: In preparation for the big day, we have transferred one of the §YEther Drake's Fangs§! to §Y[Target.GetName]§!. Getting them into the transport ship was a challenge, as the Ether Drake's unique biology does not seem to follow the laws of physics. The fang reacted particularly strangely to the transport ship entering the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s atmosphere: it began unraveling before us, and if the transport ship hadn't responded quickly, we might have lost the coveted artifact.

entries.zh: 建造一个更好的容器，把獠牙带下来。
entries.en: Construct a better container and bring the fang down.

entries.zh: 这奇怪的反应可比[Owner.GetParadeStudy]好玩多了。
entries.en: This reaction is much more interesting than any [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

entries.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以展开对反应的研究。
entries.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of studying the reaction.
Replace the fang with a replica.

entries.zh: 这将会降低该机遇产出的凝聚力。
entries.en: This will reduce the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

entries.zh: 摘取§Y裂爪龙之眼§!是一项混乱不堪的工程，开始阶段错误百出。幸运的是，这只巨兽有许多只眼睛让我们逐一试错。我们将这只眼睛拖到了[Target.Solar_System.GetName]以后发生一件又奇妙又恶心的事情：这只眼睛迅速地黏住了当地的传感阵列，并将自己牢牢地嵌在上面，俯视着§Y[Target.GetName]§!。事件的起因还在调查当中，但需要重申，这只巨龙的许多生理学知识仍是我们未知的。\n\n眼睛还没有和恒星基地完全融为一体，但我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为如果我们想继续进行之前的计划，就必须阻止这个状况。
entries.en: The extraction of the §YShard's Eye§! was a messy process with a few false starts. Luckily, the behemoth had a lot of eyes for us to practice on. We then towed the optic to [Target.Solar_System.GetName], and something both fascinating and revolting happened: the oculus started attaching and integrating itself into the local sensor array overlooking §Y[Target.GetName]§!. The cause of this is unknown, but then again, much of the Drake's physiology is beyond us.\n\nThe fusing is not complete yet, but our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it has to be halted now if we wish to proceed with our previous plans.

entries.zh: 让我们用裂爪龙之眼审视世界吧。
entries.en: Let us see with the sight of The Shard!

entries.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以把这只眼睛用于其他用途。
entries.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of using the eye for a different purpose.

entries.zh: 快把它抠下来，最后期限要到了！
entries.en: Scrape it off, we have deadlines to reach.

entries.zh: 小心地把它取下来，我们可不想有什么磕碰。
entries.en: Very carefully remove it, we wouldn't want to damage it.

entries.zh: §Y无畏战舰反应堆§!在运抵§Y[Target.GetName]§!之前一直是一个超级乖乖的货物，抵达后我们将其安置在一处仓库内以待那一天的到来。这下问题就来了：在无人照看的情况下，这台反应堆突然自己重启了。反应堆迸射出巨大的等离子电弧，整座仓库由内而外发出耀眼的光，整座建筑似乎很快就要被熔化了。\n\n我们[Owner.GetScientistPlural]反应迅速，力挽狂澜，于是现在我们就有了一台运转中的反应堆了。
entries.en: The §YDreadnought's Reactor§! was a very well-behaved cargo until it arrived at §Y[Target.GetName]§!, where we placed it in a warehouse awaiting its big day. It was there the troubles began: while no one was looking, the reactor restarted itself. The warehouse was lit up from within as it spouted out huge arcs of plasma, threatening to melt down the entire building.\n\nThe quick actions of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] were just sufficient to save it in the nick of time, with the upshot that we now have an active reactor to do with as we please.
Attach it to the [Target.GetPlanetHabitat]'s power grid.

entries.zh: 这将会提升该机遇产出的凝聚力。
entries.en: This will increase the amount of unity the opportunity will produce.

entries.zh: 即便我们预警了外星污染的危险，但还是有东西搞砸了。§Y族母的鞭毛§!运入§Y[Target.GetName]§!首都时，它以某种方式接触了其中一个管运者，然后几乎是瞬间，它就发生了变化。这件战利品上长出了脉动的附肢，变成了一团搅动的肉质。慢慢地它逐渐细化，然后竟然长成了那个被接触的管运者的模样！似乎是族母的再生能力接纳了我们物种的基因，并开始产出更多的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: Even with our xeno-contamination precautions, something went wrong. As the §YMatriarch's Flagella§! entered §Y[Target.GetName]'s§! capital, it somehow got in contact with one of the handlers, and instantly, the flagella started reacting. Pulsating ripping appendages began growing from the Trophy, first forming an indistinct churning mass of flesh. Over time it became more detailed, and to our surprise, it assumed the shape of the unfortunate handler! It seems like the regenerative powers of the Matriarch have accepted the DNA of our kind and are now in the process of generating more [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 让围观者也一起尝尝这个！
entries.en: Use this to feed the onlookers!
Let the reaction run its course.

entries.zh: 将§Y天空龙羽翼§!带回家的时候，我们的货运飞船发现他们经过的超空间航道发生了二次扭曲。期限认为只是普通的异常现象而忽视了，直到飞船进入§Y[Target.Solar_System.GetName]§!时才发现，有一团追逐着飞船的实体导致了超空间航道膨胀：一窝龙的幼崽热切追逐着我们的货运飞船，从中鱼贯而出进入我们的星系。他们应该是躲藏在跳跃点附近跟随者我们出来航道的。这些小龙似乎没有它们亲代的智力，而是漫无目的地跟随着我们——确切地说是跟随着羽翼。
entries.en: While carrying home the §YSky Dragon's Plume§!, our transportation ship noticed that the hyperlane they traveled through had a second distortion beyond their ship. Initially disregarding this as just an anomaly, it was not apparent until the ship entered §Y[Target.Solar_System.GetName]§! that a group of pursuing entities was causing the hyperlane-dilation: a clutch of dragon whelps exited into our system in hot pursuit of our transport ship. They must have lain in hiding near the jump point and followed our exit. The dragonlings do not seem to possess the mental faculties of their progenitor and seem to be aimlessly following us or, more particularly, the plume.

entries.zh: 我们得在[Target.Solar_System.GetName]为他们设立一个栖息地。
entries.en: We should set up a sanctuary for them in [Target.Solar_System.GetName].

entries.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以开辟一颗小行星让幼崽居住。
entries.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of giving an asteroid for the whelplings to inhabit.

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]还迎来了一群活体成员该有多好！
entries.en: Imagine having live subjects for the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]!

entries.zh: 警告性开火，把它们吓跑！
entries.en: Fire some warning shots, drive them off!

entries.zh: 今天早晨，在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上有个惊喜等着我们，§Y拾荒机器人压缩机§!在我们的储存设施里吐出了最后一块它的作品。这一大块合金比我们所能想象所能产出的最致密的合金还要紧实，仅需数立方米就可以建造出一整艘战列舰。这一喜出望外的发展让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信他们有希望让压缩机以§G0.001%§!的功率重新运作。
entries.en: This morning, a surprise awaited us on §Y[Target.GetName]§! as the §YScavenger Bot's Compactor§! deposited the last of its creations in our storage facility. The large chunk of alloys was denser and more compact than anything we could ever hope to produce, containing enough metals in a few cubic meters to build an entire battleship. This fantastic development has our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believing that they can get the compactor working again at §G0.001%§! efficiency, if we should wish it.

entries.zh: 把它拆了用来造点东西。
entries.en: Break it apart and use it for construction.

entries.zh: 把压缩机丢回太空运转。
entries.en: Return the Compactor to space and let it work.

entries.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以重新激活压缩机，在[Target.GetName]的轨道上制造$d_alloys_10$矿藏。
entries.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of reactivating the compactor and gaining a $d_alloys_10$ deposit in orbit of [Target.GetName].

entries.zh: §Y星际幽魂散发器囊§!这发出的斑驳光芒看起来格外引人注目，以至于让人差点没发现这个幽魂用来产生护盾的囊发生了泄露。在快速确认里面的化学物质不会导致§Y[Target.GetName]§!生态系统崩溃之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]专注于分析这些气体对我们大气的影响。\n\n似乎这些泄露的化学物质已经混入了我们大气的中间层，正在高效地散发其中凝聚的能量。如果我们继续散发其中的物质，它甚至可以有效地提高我们行星的防御能力。
entries.en: The strobing lights of the §YStellar Wraith's Disperser Sack§! were distracting to look upon, so distracting that it took a while to detect that the sack the Wraith used to generate its natural shield was leaking. After quickly confirming that exposure to the chemicals inside would not cause a total ecological collapse on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] focused on analyzing the effects the gas had on our atmosphere.\n\nIt seems like the emitted chemicals have fused with our mesosphere and disperse concentrated energies surprisingly well. So well that if we release the rest of the disperser's contents, there would be a noticeable increase in planetary defensiveness.

entries.zh: 把里面的气体抽出来完成反应。
entries.en: Extract the rest of the gas and let the reaction finish.
Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of infusing [Target.GetName]'s atmosphere with the $wraiths_energy_disperser$.

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]向[Target.Solar_System.GetName]汇报了运输§Y恐怖负相物质§!的货运飞船上的奇怪的现象。我们被包括通向纯粹苦痛与毁灭低语的世界窗口之类的恼人的幻想所袭扰。据信原因就是[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]的团块，我们有理由担忧如果将船上的这玩意带到§Y[Target.GetName]§!到底会发生什么。
entries.en: Our [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] have been reporting strange activity on the ship transporting the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! to [Target.Solar_System.GetName]. Windows into worlds of pure pain and whispers of destruction are just a few of the disturbing accounts we have received. It's believed that the mass of the [This.GetLeviathanTargetName] is to blame, and we might rightfully worry what would happen if we were to bring the ship's cargo to §Y[Target.GetName]§!.
Return it to whence it came.

entries.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以保护[Target.GetName]上[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的安全和精神健康。
entries.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of protecting the safety and sanity of the [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Target.GetName].
No! We need to study this.

entries.zh: 包好它，我不希望这个现象散布开去。
entries.en: Contain it, we can't let this phenomenon spread.

entries.zh: 它可以赐予我们神圣的智慧。
entries.en: It could teach us of the Divine.

entries.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向另一个世界裂隙。这一现象突破了抑制措施，开始在[This.GetName]上蔓延。所有与这一维度接触的事物，哪怕是不经意地透过观测设备查看，都让进行观察的[Owner.GetTeamMember]感受到剧烈的痛苦。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]担忧事态还可能进一步扩大，但同时保证只要再花一点时间他们就能解开另一个维度的奥秘了。
entries.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed: the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! on §Y[This.GetName]§! has been tearing holes in our very reality, opening rifts into another world. The phenomenon has breached the containment procedures and now seems to be expanding into [This.GetName]'s capital. Any contact with the dimension, even inadvertently through the lens of observational devices, causes intense distress on the observing [Owner.GetTeamMember]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are worried that his can spread even further but also promise that with just a bit more time they can unlock the secrets of the other dimension.

entries.zh: 此前的传言一语成谶了：§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!正在我们的现实上撕开裂口，打开通向一个纯粹邪恶世界的裂隙。任何窥视裂隙的人都会立刻陷入疯狂，直到数个小时之后才停止尖叫。我们的牧师们长年以来都在思考着我们所击败的这一实体的存在而一无所获，如今却说他们即将顿悟了。“再给我们点时间吧！”他们恳求，然而我们的科学家警告，如果再不加以控制，事态可能会变得不可收拾。
entries.en: What was only rumors before has now been confirmed; the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! on §Y[This.GetName]§! has been tearing holes in our very reality into a world of pure evil. Anyone even glancing towards one of the rifts needs hours of solitude just to stop screaming. As our priests have been contemplating the very existence of the being we defeated for several years now without any great epiphany, they say that they are approaching one now. "We just need a bit more time!" They implore, while our scientist warn us that the process might be irreversible if we allow it to go on much further.
The discoveries are worth the risk!

entries.zh: 我们需要见到真正的神圣视界。
entries.en: We need to see the true vision of the Divine.

entries.zh: 我们必须学会恶咒才能击败它。
entries.en: We must know the Anathema to defeat it.
No, the danger is too great.

entries.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们在研究其他维度时获得的科学突破是革命性的，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。尽管几乎没有[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有信心能控制住反应，但这并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
entries.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. §Y[This.GetName]§! is being ripped apart from the inside as the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! is still sequestered on it. While the breakthroughs we have had in the sciences from studying the other dimension are revolutionary, its strain on the world has been immense. Few [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe that they can still stabilize the reaction, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

entries.zh: 可能我们狂妄自大过了头。尽管在§Y[This.GetName]§!上的§Y恐怖负相物质§!仍封存良好，但整颗行星还是在被它从内而外逐渐撕碎。虽然我们对这个纯粹痛苦的维度有了许多了解，但它对行星的负担同样不可承受。几乎没有牧师敢保证自己能净化这团物质，但并不是完全没有机会！在[This.GetName]的居民正在逐渐登船离开[This.GetPlanetHabitat]时，无数的空间裂口张开了。很快事态将会变得不可挽回。
entries.en: Perhaps our hubris was too great. §Y[This.GetName]§! is being ripped apart from the inside as the §YHorrific Inverse Mass§! is still sequestered on it. While we have learned much about the dimension of pure pain, the strain on the world has been immense. Few priests still believe that they purify the mass, but there is a chance! As inhabitants of [This.GetName] board transport ships to leave the [This.GetPlanetHabitat], an innumerable amount of rifts are opening up. The point of no return is fast approaching.

entries.zh: 我们做得太过头了，恐怕已经无力回天。
entries.en: We have come too far to see it end now.

entries.zh: 如果我们就此止步就是向恶咒认输！
entries.en: If we stop now the Anathema wins!
Get rid of it, by any means necessary!

entries.zh: 晴空永远消失了，它不是被乌云荫蔽，而是被纯粹的虚空所笼罩。§Y[This.GetName]§!所残存的只有漂浮在虚无之海的陆地碎片。所有来不及逃离[This.GetPlanetHabitat]的人在其上的每一刻都在承受着无上的痛苦。我们为专家们争取到了尽可能多的时间。一个扭曲而恼人的声音回响在行星的上空：§R“对寸——回—回归于我——吧。”§!
entries.en: The sky is gone. It's not covered by clouds. It has been replaced by a pure void. All that remains of §Y[This.GetName]§! is patches of ground in the ocean of nothingness. Everyone left on the [This.GetPlanetHabitat] is suffering pure agony for every instant that passes. We have bought as much time as we could for our specialists. A distorted and disturbed voice echoes from the world beyond §R"YesS re-reTURN to mee-."§!

entries.zh: 在击败了神秘堡垒之后，它的一个舱段漂浮在太空中，我们决定将其带回[Target.Solar_System.GetName]，成为我们[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的一部分。一些[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在进入§Y神秘堡垒舱室§!深处后都失踪了。自它运抵§Y[Target.GetName]§!时，我们每天都派出[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]进入探索，但今天早些时候它内部的某些结构发生了变化。舱门自发地折叠消失了，只留下无尽的舱壁嘲笑着我们的工作人员们的狂怒。我们仍能与被困的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]取得联络，但我们目前没有想出能不破坏该结构为前提的营救方案。看来神秘堡垒还有最后一个未解之谜。
entries.en: After defeating the Enigmatic Fortress, a section of it was floating in space, so we decided to bring it to [Target.Solar_System.GetName] to be a part of our [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Several [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gone missing inside the depths of the §YChamber from the Fortress§!. Ever since it arrived on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, we have had [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] exploring it daily, yet something inside the structure shifted earlier today. Doors folded in on themselves, leaving only sheer walls for our agents to rail against. We can still communicate with the trapped [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], but we have no clear idea of getting them out without damaging the structure. It seems that the Enigmatic Fortress had one last secret.

entries.zh: 我们承担不起切割舱室的代价。
entries.en: We can't risk despoiling the Chamber.

entries.zh: 我们可以用这个方法来关押罪大恶极之人。
entries.en: We could use this technology to contain our undesirables.

entries.zh: 把这个舱室做成一个密室逃脱游戏让游行参与者来玩。
entries.en: Set the structure up as a puzzle room for parade-goers to explore.

entries.zh: §Y虚空孳孽毒腺§!中的污染物发生了严重泄露！这些毁灭性的毒液已经污染了我们§Y[Target.GetName]§!的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源，迫使我们从其他的星球运输[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]来缓解这场自作自受的大干旱。
entries.en: The containment for the §YVoidspawn's Venom Gland§! has sprung a leak! The devastating venom has now poisoned our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on §Y[Target.GetName]§!, forcing us to ferry [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] from other worlds to alleviate the self-imposed drought.

entries.zh: $situation.1110.desc.base$这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎摄入的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]来说都剧毒无比。$situation.1110.desc.end$
entries.en: $situation.1110.desc.base$ The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to be incredibly toxic to any [Owner.GetSpeciesName] that has ingested it. $situation.1110.desc.end$

entries.zh: $situation.1110.desc.base$这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液对任何不慎接触的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]沉积岩皮来说都具有极强的腐蚀性。$situation.1110.desc.end$
entries.en: $situation.1110.desc.base$ The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to be incredibly corrosive to any [Owner.GetSpeciesName] that got it on their sedimentary skin. $situation.1110.desc.end$

entries.zh: $situation.1110.desc.base$这种演化出来用以杀死硕大无朋的巨型太空兽群、溶穿厚重装甲板的毒液即时混进我们的冷却剂以后都是极具腐蚀性的。任何使用了这些受污染的冷却剂的单位都会立刻停止运转。$situation.1110.desc.end$
entries.en: $situation.1110.desc.base$ The venom, which evolved to incapacitate titanic Space Fauna and melt through hull plating, has proven to interact corrosively when exposed to our coolant. Any units using the contaminated coolant quickly stopped functioning. $situation.1110.desc.end$

entries.zh: 我们现在得研究如何解决这场危机。\n\n我们是要在[Target.GetPlanetHabitat]从分子层面上净化掉所有虚空孳孽的基因，或是慢慢地将这些毒液过滤掉，以继续进行我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]？
entries.en: We now must decide how to handle this crisis.\n\nDo we perform a molecular purge of all Voidspawn DNA on our [Target.GetPlanetHabitat], or do we slowly filter the venom out so that we can proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]?

entries.zh: 控制污染的扩散，保障[Owner.GetParadeStudy]继续进行。
entries.en: Contain the spread but don't cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy].

entries.zh: 在污染清理干净之后再举办[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。
entries.en: Pause the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] until the contaminant is cleared up.

entries.zh: 把污染物和那个毒腺一并清理出去！
entries.en: Cleanse the world of the contaminant and the venom sack!

entries.zh: 取消[Owner.GetParadeStudy]以尽快清理这颗星球。
entries.en: Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of quickly cleaning the world.

entries.zh: 在几个月的努力后，我们在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源终于移除了虚空孳孽污染变得清洁可用。这并不是徒劳一场，反之，我们在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]中学到了许多异星生理学的基本知识，并且已经准备好继续进行[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，只要[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的研究得出结果，他们就能以其提升[Target.GetName]的生活质量。
entries.en: After many months of effort, our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on §Y[Target.GetName]§! is finally clear of the Voidspawn Contaminant. It was not a wasted effort, as we have learned much from the xeno-biology present in our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] and are now ready to proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] now think that they can improve life on [Target.GetName] with the these discoveries once the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] concludes.

entries.zh: 我们遗留在噬星者最终被击杀的地方的探测器汇报，那具遗骸的一部分开始和恒星融为一体。释放的能量增进了恒星活动，但我们的计算表明，由于移除了§Y卵鞘§!，这仍不足以让§Y[dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系恢复原有的光明。如果我们让货运飞船返回，我们有希望可以重新点亮这颗恒星。
entries.en: The observation probes we had left behind at the site of the Stellar Devourer's final demise report that portions of the body have started to merge back into the star. The energy seems to have increased stellar activity, but with the removal of the §YEgg Sac§!, our calculations state that it won't be enough to restore the §Y[dead_stellarite.solar_system.GetName]§! system to its former luster. If we turn our transport ship back now, we could still potentially reignite the star.

entries.zh: 归还卵鞘，并看看我们能做些什么。
entries.en: Return the Egg Sac and see what can be done.
Cancel the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] in favor of attempting to reignite the [dead_stellarite.system.GetName] star.
No, we are bringing the Egg Sac to [Target.GetName].

entries.zh: \n\n他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
entries.en: \n\nTheir cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert until they are ready to be introduced to the system's primary star. The transport ship will have to go dark for a while as they further infiltrate the [Target.GetSpeciesAdj] capital.

entries.zh: [Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。$situation.1125.desc.base$
entries.en: The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.$situation.1125.desc.base$

entries.zh: 构成[Target.GetName]核心的星光三重奏照耀着我们的货运飞船的船体驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]星系。$situation.1125.desc.base$
entries.en: The trio of lights that form the heart of the [Target.GetName] glinted off our transport ship's hull as it entered the S[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.$situation.1125.desc.base$

entries.zh: 在踏出了驶向赐予[Target.capital_star.GetName]生命恒星的旅途的第一步之后，我们的货运飞船仍在继续挺进[Target.GetName]宇域。$situation.1125.desc.base$
entries.en: After having finished the first leg of their journey to the life-giving [Target.capital_star.GetName] star, our transport ship ventures further into [Target.GetName] space.$situation.1125.desc.base$

entries.zh: 运载噬星者的货运飞船已经通过了恒星系的安全检查，其中使用的密码是此前由$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]所捕获的，这对顺利通行至关重要。我们的操作员已经开始将这些噬星者宝宝重新解冻以恢复其活动。货运飞船将再次瞄准恒星系的首要恒星，作为这次旅途的终点。
entries.en: Our Stellar Devourer transport has cleared the system's security check - the security codes that $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been gathering were crucial for passing into the system. Our operatives have started the heating procedure to get the baby Stellar Devourers moving. They will again aim for the system's primary star for the transport ship's final voyage.

entries.zh: 离开货运飞船，进入燃烧的等离子体
entries.en: Out of the Transport Ship, Into the Burning Plasma

entries.zh: 我们已经收到来自$role_spymaster$[spynetwork.leader.GetName]的密电：一切就绪。我们的操作员已经开始弃船操作，只保留下核心船员。一旦舰船加速到最大的亚光速航速，他们也会在飞船撞击这个星系的首要恒星之前脱离，以确保我们不留下任何蛛丝马迹。\n\n噬星者宝宝们已经开始躁动不安。如果我们再不快点执行操作，它们可能都要开始打起飞船燃料的主意了。
entries.en: We have received word back from $role_spymaster$ [spynetwork.leader.GetName]: everything is ready. Our operatives have already started abandoning the transport ship, leaving only a skeleton crew behind. Once the ship hits its maximum sublight speed, they too will escape just before the transport crashes into the system's primary star, ensuring we leave no evidence behind.\n\nThe Stellar Devourers have started to get quite agitated. If we don't commence the operation soon, they might make their way into the transport's fuel supply.

entries.zh: 我们干预行动的最后证据很快在恒星的日冕层熔化了。我们的传感器在撞击后的一瞬间焚毁，但这足以证明我们已经成功地感染了§Y[From.target.capital_star.GetName]§!。\n\n我们已经为这个恒星系写下了残酷而寒冷的终章。
entries.en: The last proof of our tampering quickly melted inside the star's corona. Our sensors burned up moments after impact, but that was enough to confirm that we had successfully infested §Y[From.target.capital_star.GetName]§!.\n\nWe may just have doomed an entire solar system to a cruel, cold death.

entries.zh: 我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。
entries.en: We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar radiation.

entries.zh: $situation.1145.desc.base$\n\n[capital_scope.GetName]上的居民已经开始囤积核热毯，减少外出。希望我们能尽早回到温暖的日子。
entries.en: $situation.1145.desc.base$\n\nInhabitants of [capital_scope.GetName] have taken to stocking up on fission-powered blankets and minimizing trips outside. Hopefully, we will return to warmer times soon.

entries.zh: $situation.1145.desc.base$\n\n我们已经分派了更多的能量用于产热，并指示所有子个体凑成团簇一同行动以减少热量散失。我们一定能熬过去的。
entries.en: $situation.1145.desc.base$\n\nWe have allocated more energy to our heating budget and have instructed all drones to huddle closer to each other to preserve heat. We will endure this.

entries.zh: $situation.1145.desc.base$\n\n尽管这场骚动触动了我们共同本能深处的恐惧，但鉴于我们知晓母星此前造成的破坏：我们将坚持下去。我们已分配更多能量用于供暖我们的庇护所，而我们的共生体们也将学会为了取暖而更加紧密地依偎在一起。
entries.en: $situation.1145.desc.base$\n\nThough this disturbance strikes fear into the core of our shared instincts, knowing the damage our home star has wreaked before: we shall endure. We have allocated more energy for heating our sheltered dwellings, and our symbionts shall learn to huddle closer to each other for warmth.

entries.zh: §Y[capital_star.GetName]§!内部的聚变反应持续低迷的时长前所未见。由于其辐照能量的骤减，[capital_scope.GetName]上已经发生了多种生态灾害，如果继续下去，我们可能将面临冰河时期。所有的空间站和定居点都遭遇到了相似的情况。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]确信一定有什么蹊跷，希望能研究[capital_star.GetName]。
entries.en: The fusion chain reaction inside of §Y[capital_star.GetName]§! has now been on a steady downturn for an unprecedented amount of time. There are active ecological disasters on [capital_scope.GetName] due to the lowered radiation, and if this continues, we might be looking at an ice age. All stations and other places of residence in the system are suffering from similar issues. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] are sure that there is something abnormal afoot and desire to investigate [capital_star.GetName].

entries.zh: 查查到底发生了什么事！
entries.en: Figure out what is going on!

entries.zh: §R[capital_star.GetName]被微型噬星者感染了！§!我们不明白这些星神兽幼体到底是怎么跑到我们的恒星上的，明明它们不具有任何超光速能力。我们可以在未来对其进行研究，但当下我们最要紧的是研究如何停止它们的寄生，否则我们的整个首都就要被彻底冻死了。
entries.en: §R[capital_star.GetName] is infested with tiny Stellar Devourers!§! We have no clue how these neonate leviathans have managed to get to our star as they don't seem to possess any FTL capabilities. We can uncover all that later. For now, we need to discover a way to stop the parasites before our capital freezes over.
Well, get them out of there!

entries.zh: 今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星§Y[target.GetName]§!熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
entries.en: Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star §Y[target.GetName]§! went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and permanent ice age. [target.GetName] itself has shrunken to become a brown dwarf star, meaning life remaining in the system will permanently be diminished.

entries.zh: $situation.1170.desc.base$\n很遗憾，究竟是什么把这些噬星者带到我们星系的仍不得而知。目前是灾后重建的时候了。
entries.en: $situation.1170.desc.base$\nSadly, this freak occurrence that delivered the Stellar Devourers to our system will remain a mystery. For now, we must rebuild.

entries.zh: $situation.1170.desc.base$\n我们推测这些噬星者很有可能是由§Y[star_infesters.GetName]§!送到我们的恒星上的，现在我们要他们血债血偿。
entries.en: $situation.1170.desc.base$\nWe know that these Devourers were purposely introduced to our star by the §Y[star_infesters.GetName]§! - and now they shall suffer.

entries.zh: §Y以太巨龙§!的尖牙是这个星球首府的重中之重。
entries.en: The fang of an §YEther Drake§! is the centerpiece of this world's capital.

entries.zh: §Y以太巨龙§!的尖牙正在我们大气层的附近逐渐腐坏，对其进行研究能够让我们了解这个宇宙之前有什么存在。
entries.en: Studying the §YEther Drake's§! fang as it decays near our atmospheres gives us insights into whatever existed before this universe did.

entries.zh: 通过亵渎的机械—异星生物学融合技术，这个恒星系的传感阵列可以触及的范围远远超过正常手段能够到达的极限。
entries.en: By the unholy fusion of machine and xeno-biology, the sensor arrays in this system can reach far beyond what we normally would be able to.

entries.zh: 在§Y裂爪龙§!不停监视的眼睛之下，这个星球的人群工作起来更加卖力了。
entries.en: Under the watchful eye of §YThe Shard§! the population on this world seem to work harder.

entries.zh: §Y自动无畏战舰§!上拆卸下来的反应堆正给这个星球的一部分供能。
entries.en: A reactor from the §YAutomated Dreadnought§! partially powers this world.

entries.zh: 让§Y自动无畏战舰§!反应堆暂时性涨高能量，可以为这个星球的每一个岗位提供能源。
entries.en: A temporary boon from the §YAutomated Dreadnought's§! reactor is helping power every job on this world.

entries.zh: 此前毫无动静的§Y缇扬奇族母§!的鞭毛开始产出这个行星上当地居民的一些复制体。
entries.en: The Flagella of the §YTiyanki Matriarch§!, initially inert, has started generating copies of the inhabitants on this world.

entries.zh: 被烧焦的§Y缇扬奇族母鞭毛§!残骸在该行星的首府展出。
entries.en: The cauterized remains of the §YTiyanki Matriarch's Flagella§! adorn this world's capital.

entries.zh: §Y天空龙§!的反重力能力使我们在这颗行星上获得了更多的宜居空间，并且加深了我们对该现象的科学了解。
entries.en: The §YSky Dragon's§! gravity-defying properties grant us more habitable space on the world and give us scientific insights into the phenomenon.

entries.zh: §Y拾荒机器人§!的压缩器帮助我们优化了冶金流程。
entries.en: The §YScavenger Bot's§! compactor helps us optimize our metallurgical processes.

entries.zh: 能量散布器囊中忽明忽灭的亮光令人十分愉悦放松。
entries.en: The pulsating lights from the Disperser Sack are very pleasant and relaxing.

entries.zh: 该大气层灌注了光谱幽魂的自然能量，降低了轨道轰炸的有效性。
entries.en: This atmosphere has been infused by the natural energy of the Spectral Wraith, making orbital bombardment less effective.

entries.zh: 另一维度生命体的残骸，它在这个世界的存在似乎是对自然秩序的一种违抗。
entries.en: The remains of a being from another dimension, its very presence on this world seems to be an affront to the natural order of things.

entries.zh: 这些负相物质与我们的维度兼容性不佳，具有将我们的行星撕裂的倾向。
entries.en: The inverse mass has been reacting poorly with our dimension and seems to be actively trying to tear our world apart.

entries.zh: 我们磨蹭了太久。这颗行星的命运已经不再掌握在我们手中了。
entries.en: We have waited too long. This world's fate is no longer ours to decide.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上发生了一个奇迹：§Y负相物质§!所有怪异的特性都被稳定化了，现在可以安全地进行研究。
entries.en: A miracle has occurred on [Root.GetName]: against all odds the §YInverse Mass§! stabilized and can now be studied without any danger.

entries.zh: 该[This.GetPlanetHabitat]存放着一间从神秘堡垒拆解下来的舱室，无论当地居民从上面取下什么，它大多时候都能够无限再生。
entries.en: This [This.GetPlanetHabitat] hosts a Chamber from the Enigmatic Fortress, capable of reforming itself for whatever the inhabitants need, most of the time.

entries.zh: 这颗行星被$voidspawns_chitin$所污染，需要尽快清理。
entries.en: This world has been tainted by the $voidspawns_chitin$ and must now be cleaned up.

entries.zh: 净化后的虚空滋孽毒液腺在这颗行星上展出。它曾因为发生泄露而停止展示，但现在又对公众开放了。
entries.en: The cleansed Venom Gland of the Void adorns this world. After an initial leak stopped it from being displayed, now it's visible for all.

entries.zh: 星系内噬星者卵中最后的收集品。
entries.en: The last collection of Stellar Devourer Eggs in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 这颗行星正遭受异常低的恒星能量输出，生活变得相当不适。
entries.en: This world is experiencing abnormally low solar output from their star, making life rather uncomfortable.

entries.zh: 这颗行星正遭受严峻的恒星低能量输出。
entries.en: This world is experiencing drastically lower solar output from its star.

entries.zh: 由于噬星者对恒星的寄生，这颗行星正遭受极度危险的恒星低能量输出
entries.en: This world is experiencing dangerously low solar output from its star, due to an infestation of Stellar Devourers.

entries.zh: 找到噬星者寄生的解决方案。
entries.en: Find a Cure for the Stellar Devourer Infestation

entries.zh: §Y[This.GetName]§!受到噬星者的寄生。我们不确定它们从何而来，只知道必须尽快移除它们，否则星系内的所有生命都将在劫难逃。
entries.en: §Y[This.GetName]§! has become infested with Stellar Devourers. We are unsure where they came from, but they need to be removed soon or else all life in the system might be at an end.

entries.zh: 这些怪诞地搏动着的鞭毛必须处理掉。
entries.en: The pulsating grotesque flagella has to go.

entries.zh: 我国拥有$devourers_plasma$，就可以驯养一批微型噬星者。我们的任务是决定把它们丢到哪颗恒星上。
entries.en: With the $devourers_plasma$ within our empire, we have access to a horde of tiny Stellar Devourers. We just need to decide which star to consume.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n用噬星者感染[target.GetName]的母恒星，并将其逐渐吞噬。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nInfest [target.GetName] capital star with Stellar Devourers, which will slowly consume the star.

entries.zh: 目标帝国的首都围绕一颗黑洞运行，噬星者对那里毫无兴趣。
entries.en: The target empire's capital orbits a black hole, leaving our Stellar Devourers nothing to eat.

entries.zh: 我们无法触及被戴森球包围的恒星。
entries.en: We cannot reach the star as it's sealed within a Dyson Sphere.

entries.zh: 这个帝国已经研究清楚如何对付我们的噬星者了。
entries.en: This empire has figured out how to counteract our Stellar Devourers.

entries.zh: 这个帝国的首都恒星已经被噬星者侵蚀。
entries.en: This empire's capital star is already infested with Stellar Devourers.

entries.zh: 发动战争，彻底征服吞噬我们恒星的敌人。
entries.en: War is waged to utterly conquer the enemy that ate our star.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以彻底地征服我们吞噬了其恒星的敌人。
entries.en: War is waged to utterly conquer the enemy whose star we ate.

entries.zh: 一种五彩斑斓的能源寄生虫正在侵染我们的能源电网，提高了我们的能源供给。我们可以放任它，或者通过§Y谍报行动§!将这个麻烦传导到其他帝国。\n\n[GetKaleidoscopeMood]。
entries.en: A colorful energy parasite is infecting our power grid, feasting on our energy supplies. We could indulge it, or use an §YEspionage Operation§! to pass this problem to another empire.\n\n[GetKaleidoscopeMood].

entries.zh: 让§H万华镜§!寄生虫挨饿会降低它的§Y心情§!，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
entries.en: Starving the §HKaleidoscope§! will lower its §Ymood§!, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

entries.zh: 万华镜寄生虫的§Y心情§!会决定最后的结果。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope's §Ymood§! will determine the final outcome.

entries.zh: 降低§Y心情§!。一只挨饿的万华镜寄生虫会大发雷霆，给我们造成麻烦。
entries.en: Lowers §Ymood§!. A starved Kaleidoscope will lash out and give us trouble.

entries.zh: 提高§Y心情§!。一只满意的万华镜寄生虫会绽放满足的光线，几乎不会带来麻烦。
entries.en: Improves §Ymood§!. A sated Kaleidoscope will produce pleasing lights and little trouble.

entries.zh: 极大地改善§Y心情§!。一只撑饱的万华镜寄生虫不会给我们造成麻烦，但是这么做开销极大。
entries.en: Greatly improves §Ymood§!. An overstuffed Kaleidoscope will give us no trouble, but it will cost us dearly.

entries.zh: 万华镜寄生虫在§P生气§!，随时都会大发雷霆。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope is §Pangry§! and ready to lash out at any moment.

entries.zh: 万华镜寄生虫处于§S宁静§!状态。它只要能得到食物就不会胡来。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope is §Sserene§!. As long as it receives food, it should not misbehave.

entries.zh: 万华镜寄生虫很§B愉悦§!。它的颜色五彩绚烂，如同其心情一样。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope is §Bjoyful§!. Its colors are as splendid as its mood.

entries.zh: 某种东西——或者某个人——正在吸收我们的电网。
entries.en: Something - or someone - is draining our power grid.

entries.zh: 万华镜的花朵如梦似幻、稍纵即逝，其花瓣处于不断变化的状态，具有操纵、吸收和反射光波的能力。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope's bloom is a fragile florescence of ever-shifting petals, possessing the ability to manipulate, absorb, and reflect light waves.

entries.zh: 依据你的首都恒星系的§Y恒星类型§!，获取持续10年的不同类型产出加成。
entries.en: Grants a different resource production bonus for 10 years depending on the §YStar Class§! of your capital system.

entries.zh:
根据首都星系恒星类型产生加成：

—§YB型§!：§G+75§!£alloys£合金
—§YA型§!：§G+150§!£consumer_goods£消费品
—§YF型§!：§G+300§!£food£食物
—§YG型§!：§G+300§!£energy£能量
—§YK型§!：§G+300§!£minerals£矿物
—§YM型§!：§G+30§!£rare_crystals£稀有水晶
—§Y红巨星§!：§G+15§!£sr_living_metal£活体金属
—§Y褐矮星§!：§G+30§!£volatile_motes£易爆微粒
—§Y脉冲星§!：§G+15§!£sr_zro£
—§Y黑洞§!：§G+15§!£sr_dark_matter£暗物质
—§Y中子星§!：§G+15§!£nanites£纳米机器人
—§Y翠光使§!：§G+30§!£exotic_gases£异星天然气
—§Y古代裂隙§!：§G+15§!£astral_threads£星界丝缕

双星和三星系统提供组成恒星类型效果的总和。
entries.en:
The bonus granted depends on the star class of your capital system:

- §YClass B§!: §G+75§! £alloys£ Alloys
- §YClass A§!: §G+150§! £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods
- §YClass F§!: §G+300§! £food£ Food
- §YClass G§!: §G+300§! £energy£ Energy
- §YClass K§!: §G+300§! £minerals£ Minerals
- §YClass M§!: §G+30§! £rare_crystals£ Rare Crystals
- §YRed Giant§!: §G+15§! £sr_living_metal£ Living Metal
- §YBrown Dwarf§!: §G+30§! £volatile_motes£ Volatile Motes
- §YPulsar§!: §G+15§! £sr_zro£ Zro
- §YBlack Hole§!: §G+15§! £sr_dark_matter£ Dark Matter
- §YNeutron Star§!: §G+15§! £nanites£ Nanites
- §YViridescent Lightbringer§!: §G+30§! £exotic_gases£ Exotic Gases
- §YAncient Rift§!: §G+15§! £astral_threads£ Astral Threads

Binary and trinary systems grant the combined effects of their component star types.
It produces no energy. Only beauty.

entries.zh: 我们的人民从轨道上看到的是§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。\n\n当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
entries.en: What our people saw from orbit was §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt, hospital equipment lifeless and inert. A world-wide blackout, as sudden as it was inexplicable.\n\nAs silence and shadows veiled our world, strange light patterns bloomed in the sky, enveloping our capital system in a kaleidoscopic mist. The two events are doubtlessly related, but our [root.GetTechnicianPlural] are still - literally - in the dark.

entries.zh: 我们的传感器报告万华镜寄生虫发光图样的幻影出现在了§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系。这个现象的自然机理暂时还不清楚。
entries.en: Our sensors report the apparition of kaleidoscopic light patterns in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system. The nature of the phenomenon is unclear.

entries.zh: 我们先前观察到的万华镜幻影已经移动到了§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系。
entries.en: The kaleidoscopic apparition we previously observed has moved to the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh: 我们在自己的电网系统中找不到任何缺陷。我们的发电机正在产生能量，但是某种存在……某种存在正在吸收它。这可能是我们在天空中能够观察到光图案的结果，这个图案的几何性质透露出一定的智慧痕迹。\n\n这个东西——这个活着的§Y万华镜§!——是一个满怀恶意的存在，还是一团无意识的迷雾？答案尚未明确。
entries.en: We can find no defects in our power grid. Our generators are producing energy, but something is... absorbing it. It may be a result of the light patterns witnessed in our skies, the geometric nature of which betray an intelligent design.\n\nIs this thing - this living §YKaleidoscope§! - a malicious entity, or just a mindless mist? The answer is unclear.

entries.zh: 试图将它从我们的电网中剥离出来。
entries.en: Attempt to detach it from our power grid.

entries.zh: 多亏了我们的[owner.GetTechnicianPlural]和[owner.GetScientistPlural]的通力合作，我们设法将能量寄生虫从我们的电力网络中剔除了。我们最漫长的黑夜已经过去，但是§Y万华镜§!寄生虫仍然在我们的头顶上闪耀，渴望能量。\n\n我们无法与它进行交流，常规武器对这类生物无效。我们剩下的选项是给它提供足够的能量以维持其心情满足，或者试图让它挨饿。我们的特工还建议组织一次§Y谍报行动§!，将它引诱到另一个帝国。让其他人来处理它。
entries.en: Thanks to the coordinated effort of our [owner.GetTechnicianPlural] and [owner.GetScientistPlural], the energy parasite has been cut from our power grid. Our longest night is over, but §Ythe Kaleidoscope§! still shines upon us, hungry for energy.\n\nWe have no way to communicate with it, and conventional weaponry won't work on a being of this kind. Our remaining options are to feed it just enough to keep it appeased, or try to starve it. Our operatives also suggested organizing an §YEspionage Operation§! to lure it towards another empire. Let someone else deal with it.

entries.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是一个熟悉的图案再次出现：§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!上的所有电源突然关闭，我们的首都受到全球停电的打击，而熹微的光亮在天空中跃动。
§Y万华镜§!回来了！我们曾经将这个能量寄生虫诱骗到其他国家，现在又给送了回来。

根据我们专家的分析，投资建设一个§Y$building_planetary_shield_generator$§!能够防止我们的首都再次成为目标，但是一切都为时已晚：因为能量寄生虫已经待这儿不走了。
entries.en:
What our people saw from orbit was the repetition of a familiar pattern: all power on §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! shutting down, our capital hit by a worldwide blackout while shimmering lights danced in the sky.
§YThe Kaleidoscope§! has returned! The energy parasite we once foisted onto others has been sent back to us.

According to our experts, investing in a §Y$building_planetary_shield_generator$§! will prevent our capital from being targeted again, but it's too late for now: the energy parasite is here to stay.

entries.zh: 这个非自然的野兽别想在我们的恒星系容身！
entries.en: The unnatural monster has no space in our system!

entries.zh: 我们必须和这个奇迹之兽交好！
entries.en: We must befriend this wondrous creature!
It wants energy? Let it choke on it.

entries.zh: 依照我们经过验证和测试的流程，我们将万华镜寄生虫从§H[root.GetName]§!的能量电网中剥离，恢复了首都的供电。
entries.en: Following our proven and tested procedures, we detached the Kaleidoscope from §H[root.GetName]§!'s energy grid, restoring power to our capital.

entries.zh: 我们的特工通过假扮成技工成功渗透进入了§H[target.GetName]§!的能源区划。他们的下一项任务是安装一个返航信标，诱惑能量寄生虫前来这个行星。
entries.en: By posing as technicians, our operatives successfully infiltrated the §H[target.GetName]§!'s energy districts. Their next assignment is to install a homing beacon to lure the energy parasite to the planet.

entries.zh: 我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将§Y万华镜§!寄生虫引走了！\n\n现在就让§H[target.GetName]§!去处理这麻烦吧。
entries.en: The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring §Ythe Kaleidoscope§! away!\n\nLet the §H[target.GetName]§! deal with it now.

entries.zh: 依据我们的谍报信息，§H[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]§!，目前正遭遭受到能源短缺的困扰。我们送他们的§Y万华镜§!似乎正是这一经济困境的主要起因。
entries.en: According to our espionage reports, §H[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]§!, is currently suffering from an energy shortage. The §YKaleidoscope§! we gifted them seems to be the main cause of their economic troubles.

entries.zh: 一只饥肠辘辘的万华镜寄生虫将双齿深深扎进了§H[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]§!的能量电网中。随之而来的全殖民地范围的大停电颇为剧烈，但与此前的攻击并不相似。我们已经知道怎么对付这东西了。
entries.en: A starved Kaleidoscope has sunk its metaphorical teeth into §H[event_target:infested_planet.GetName]§!'s energy grid. The ensuing colony-wide blackout was dramatic, but not dissimilar from previous attacks. We know how to deal with this.

entries.zh: 一只贪婪的万华镜正试图强行连接到我们在§H[target.GetName]§!上的§Y能量中枢§!。这提供了一个研究这只生物独特能力的绝佳机会，但我们预计这座建筑将因此受到严重破坏。
entries.en: A ravenous Kaleidoscope is trying to forcibly connect itself to one our §YEnergy Nexus§! on §H[target.GetName]§!. This presents a remarkable opportunity to study the being's unique abilities, but we expect the building will be severely damaged as a result.

entries.zh: 就让它吃点我们的能量吧。为了科学！
entries.en: Let it eat our energy. For Science!

entries.zh: 万华镜焦躁地颤动着，让我们的天空充满了不和谐、不均匀的光线。我们的人不禁觉得这种景象令人不安。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope trembles nervously, filling our skies with jarring, uneven patterns of light. Our people can't help but find the spectacle unnerving.

entries.zh: 万华镜犹如一道敞开的窗口，让我们的天空充满了不祥而病态的图案。我们的祭祀认为这是凶兆。也许明智的做法是牺牲一些能量给这个生物，消除它的饥饿，平息我们人民的恐惧。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope throbs like an open wound, filling our skies with ominous, sickly patterns. Our priests believe it an ill omen. It may be wise to sacrifice some energy to the creature, to quench its hunger and appease our people's fears.
We shall not bend to its will.

entries.zh: 万华镜号渴求能量，它学会了如何从我们的舰队中吸取能量。尽管能量消耗很小，但对我们的航速有明显的影响。
entries.en: Hungry for energy, the Kaleidoscope has learned how to siphon energy from our fleet. The power drain is minimal, but is having a detectable impact on our ships' speed.

entries.zh: 开心的万华镜让[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的天空中涂满了令人愉悦的图形，一个个分型互相流变，带来了一波波变化万千的奇观。\n\n整颗星球仿佛静止了。人们驻足欣赏，为之惊叹。
entries.en: A happy Kaleidoscope fills [owner.capital_scope.GetName]'s skies with pleasing shapes, fractals melting into other fractals in ever-changing waves of wonder.\n\nThe planet stops. Admires. Breathes.

entries.zh: 万华镜不断变化的图案会不会是一种沟通的方式？或者这只是一种类似呼吸一般的自发流程？我们的[root.GetScientistPlural]尚未找到答案。万华镜也正在为我们带来不可估量的研究数据。
entries.en: Could the shifting patterns of the Kaleidoscope be a form of communication? Or are they an autonomous process, more akin to breathing? Our [root.GetScientistPlural] still don't have an answer. The Kaleidoscope is providing us with an invaluable amount of scientific data.

entries.zh: 我们有幸得出体验星系最壮观的灯光秀：万华镜的花瓣往复折叠、盛开、绽放！然而，我们的仪器则带来了一则不那么令人高兴的消息。\n\n这种能量生物变得如此充满力量，它甚至像一颗垂死的恒星一样发生了坍缩。在它的废墟中，我们的探测器发现了一个外形非常类似花朵的晶体团簇。根据初步研究，这种“花”可以放大最微弱的光线，在这个过程中打破了一些已知的物理定律。我们的[root.owner.GetScientistPlural]推测，这种花不过是一座光线可以被无限地反射叠加的多维镜屋中可见的冰山一角。
entries.en: We have been blessed to experience the galaxy's most splendid light show: kaleidoscopic petals folding into themselves; blooming; exploding! However, our instruments tell a less triumphant story.\n\nThe energy being became so full of power it collapsed into itself like a dying star. From the devastation, our probes retrieved a crystalline cluster, shaped very much like a flower blossom. According to preliminary studies, the 'flower' can magnify the intensity of the faintest light ray, breaking a few known laws of physics in the process. Our [root.owner.GetScientistPlural] hypothesize the flower is merely the visible part of a larger construct - a multi-dimensional house of mirrors where light beams are infinitely reflected and recombined.

entries.zh: 传感器报告§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系中万华镜的图案发生了剧烈的绽放，并在五彩斑斓的爆炸中消失了。那场面一定相当壮观。
entries.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system just bloomed, disappearing in a final burst of colorful patterns. Must have been quite the spectacle.

entries.zh: 万华镜自我折叠的一瞬，它看起来就像一朵最精致的水晶花。然而，随之而来的爆炸一点也不温和：一股灼热的爆炸席卷了整个星系，我们所有的电子设备都发生了过载，烧焦了能源电网。\n\n维修工作已经在进行中，但我们还需要一段时间才能适应这片空旷的天空。
entries.en: When the Kaleidoscope folded into itself, just for a second, it looked like the most delicate crystalline flower. However, the ensuing explosion was anything but gentle: a coruscating boom that scorched the system and overloaded all our electronic devices, frying our energy grid.\n\nRepairs are already underway, but it will take some time for us to get used to the newly empty sky.

entries.zh: 传感器报告在§H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§!恒星系的万华镜图案爆炸了，释放了一道能量冲击波损坏了星系中所有的设施。
entries.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the §H[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]§! system just exploded, releasing an energy shockwave that doubtlessly damaged every structure in the system.

entries.zh: 在在最后一阵红色的起伏图案爆发之后，万华镜消失了，它的彩色卷须像雾一样消散了。\n\n在它的光芒下度过了这么长时间后，我们的天空看起来空落落的。
entries.en: After a final burst of red, undulating patterns, the Kaleidoscope faded away, its colorful tendrils dissipating like mist.\n\nAfter so much time spent beneath its lights, our skies look almost empty.

entries.zh: 传感器回报我们在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系探测到的万华镜图案已经消退了。
entries.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern we detected in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system has faded away.

entries.zh: 万华镜寄生虫事实证明是一个异常好相处的邻居，但是要让它持续保持满足的心态不是一件容易的事情。建一个戴森球能不能满足它对能量的那种无底洞般的胃口呢？
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope has proven to be a strangely amiable neighbor, but keeping it sated has proven to be a challenge. Would a Dyson Sphere quench its endless thirst for energy?

entries.zh: 为万华镜寄生虫提供一个改版戴森球。
entries.en: Modify a Dyson Sphere for the Kaleidoscope.

entries.zh: 解锁一项新的戴森球升级。
entries.en: Unlock a new Dyson Sphere upgrade.

entries.zh: 万华镜寄生虫盘附在了我们提供的改版戴森球上，吞食着一整个恒星的能量，其不断延展的、色彩缤纷的花瓣包覆了整个恒星系。根据我们的数据，这个噬能生命体现在处于一种恒定的、可控的超载状态，在一个类似于死亡和重生的无尽循环中，不断地长出新芽，再不断地爆裂。\n\n我们不知道这个生命体是否有思考能力，但我们希望它的存在本身现在和它产生的光图案一样令人愉快。
entries.en: The Kaleidoscope has latched onto the modified Dyson Sphere we provided, consuming the energy of a star and extending its colorful petals to encompass the whole system. According to our data, the energy being is now in a state of constant, controlled overload, perpetually growing new buds and bursting in an endless cycle akin to death and rebirth.\n\nWe do not know if the being is capable of thought, but we hope its existence is now as pleasant as the patterns of light it produces.

entries.zh: 能源电网的全球性故障使我们的首都陷入了完全的黑暗。我们必须恢复§H[root.GetName]§!的电力基础设施，并压实相应责任主体。
entries.en: A global failure of the energy grid has plunged our capital into total darkness. We must restore §H[root.GetName]§!'s power infrastructure and determine what is taking place.

entries.zh: 又一次，万华镜寄生虫锁死了我们的电网，消耗我们的能源供给，使行星陷入黑暗。\n\n幸运的是，我们现在知道如何应对。
entries.en: Once again, the Kaleidoscope has latched to our power grid, consuming our energy and plunging the planet into darkness.\n\nFortunately, we now know how to respond.

entries.zh: 通过在另一个帝国的能源区划埋下一枚返航信标，我们能够将这个噬能生命体带到另一个星际帝国去祸害当地。
entries.en: By planting a homing beacon in another empire's energy districts, we can send the energy being to infect another galactic power.
Their capital world is protected by a §Y$building_planetary_shield_generator$§!.

entries.zh: 他们不会让我们这么快再次突破他们的安保。
entries.en: They won't let us get past their security again so soon.

entries.zh: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\n万华镜寄生虫将被带至[root.target.GetName]，侵染他们的首都。
entries.en: $IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$\nThe Kaleidoscope will be passed to [root.target.GetName], infecting their capital.
